headline: Jana Small Finance Bank shares drop 13% after Federal Bank denies stake acquisition plans
hook: Deal speculation ends abruptly for investors
summary: Shares of Jana Small Finance Bank plummeted 13 percent to hit a six-month low after Federal Bank clarified it has no plans to acquire a stake in the lender. The steep correction wipes out recent gains that were driven by market speculation of a potential buyout. Retail investors holding Jana SFB face sudden downside risk as the speculative premium completely evaporates from the stock price.
why_it_matters: Speculative gains vanish as acquisition rumors prove false
winners_losers: Federal Bank unhurt / Jana SFB holders hurt
